key_findings: **6 Receiver classes IDENTIFIED via vftable RTTI**: ChocoboReceiver, ChocoboGradeReceiver, GoobbueReceiver, GrandCompanyReceiver, ChangeShadowActorFlagReceiver, SetDisplayNameReceiver. All 6 are in the System or Network namespaces under Application::Lua::Script::Client::Command. These were previously TBD-class slots in the 16-factory cluster.

**BCS-S-0050 ReceiverStateCache now has 13 of 18 expected Receiver state slots mapped to identified factories AND class names** (up from 6 earlier and 8 earlier). The 5 remaining unmapped slots are likely: (a) one of the 4 zero-init gap dwords (0x14/0x24/0x34/0x4C), (b) parts of the 84-byte _mid_buffer_remainder, (c) the 2 cache-ensure stubs' targets (BCS-Y-1351/1352 don't write to cache directly; they forward to vector collection helpers on the container itself).

**5 cache fields from FUN_00771230 (SetDisplayName apply)**: display_name_id at 0x54, display_name_set_byte at 0xAC, display_name_is_unnamed at 0xAD, display_name_listener at 0xB0 (was _zero_init_b0 earlier), and display_name_set_flag at 0xB4 (was _byte_b4_TBD earlier). Fresh configured instructions establish an exact 8-byte DisplayNameResolverListener allocation at +0xB0 and correct the older decompiler-based 0x60 name-block interpretation.

**FUN_00767870 ChangeActorSubStatStatus apply uses RTTI dynamic_cast to LuaControl + StatusBase** (line 158 of c64 decomp): Component::Lua::GameEngine::LuaControl + Application::Lua::Script::Client::Control::StatusBase. Reveals two new RTTI types in the Lua control framework. The +200000 offset in FUN_00CC70E0 is interesting - likely a status-id-to-namespace-key conversion. Could surface a new architectural finding about status receiver coupling to the Lua control framework.

**The Goobbue receiver attribution clarifies the 0x01A1 'SetHasGoobbuePacket' weak-attribution concern from sibling-repo receiver-cross-reference**. GoobbueReceiver is a DISTINCT class from VehicleGradeReceiver (different vftable, different namespace prefix). The 0x01A1 attribution (which is VehicleGradeReceiver per sibling-repo) and any Goobbue-related opcodes are separate dispatch paths. This resolves a long-standing weak-attribution flag in the sibling-repo work.
